findings.statement: Windows Codex composer inserted an additional backslash in model-visible path text
findings.proposed_mitigation: Compare exact UTF-8 bytes at every UI/model boundary; reject mutated paths

findings.statement: Windows text-mode stdin transformed a fixed LF byte stream into CRLF in a local controller
findings.proposed_mitigation: Use binary stdin/stdout with exact length and SHA-256 assertions

findings.statement: PowerShell-to-CMD and nested SSH/bash/Python quoting can change intended command/target semantics
findings.proposed_mitigation: Avoid shell interpolation; pass argument arrays and framed data, use binary transport and safe fixed argv

findings.statement: Guest emitted backslash+t instead of byte 09 tab delimiter
findings.proposed_mitigation: Validate emitted guest bytes and strict parser before remote operation

findings.statement: Guest script declared main() but did not call it, yielding exit 0 without safe records
findings.proposed_mitigation: Require output schema, record cardinality and completion marker, not merely exit 0

findings.statement: Process exit zero was mistaken for functional completion
findings.proposed_mitigation: Validate actual expected artifacts, schema and application status independent of shell exit

findings.statement: A public Codex bug report describes cleanup escaping a Windows workspace
findings.proposed_mitigation: Treat destructive actions as separately authorized; resolve handles inside restricted workspace and fail closed

findings.statement: Public Windows/WSL report describes data loss from empty temporary-path expansion
findings.proposed_mitigation: Reject empty, root, device and out-of-scope paths before process launch; use disposable test roots

findings.statement: April 2026 local E: data-loss event is reported; exact upstream executor/root cause not verified
findings.proposed_mitigation: Preserve disk forensic evidence and raw command provenance privately; never reenact deletion

findings.statement: May 2026 server disruption and missing directory/rebuild history reported; original responsible command unresolved
findings.proposed_mitigation: Correlate read-only execution logs and snapshots before causal attribution

findings.statement: Unmounted or cloned volume identity reported; no full volume lineage proof
findings.proposed_mitigation: Bind volume identifier, mount identity, filesystem and snapshot before mutation

findings.statement: Junctions, symlinks and reparse points can break string-only path checks
findings.proposed_mitigation: Prove effective open handles and enforce native OS isolation; synthetic reference rejects links

findings.statement: Public Codex report describes many git processes and approximately 98 percent physical RAM usage
findings.proposed_mitigation: Enforce process-tree and concurrency quotas with OS-level budgets

findings.statement: Public issue reports commit-memory growth, freezes and app crashes
findings.proposed_mitigation: Cap virtual memory, log peak commit, watchdog and terminate owned tree on breach

findings.statement: Local process start overloads and slowdowns reported without complete per-process causal trace
findings.proposed_mitigation: Bound child-count, launch rate, CPU, memory and wall time before execution

findings.statement: Prior Windows C: free space near 1 GB and 0x80070070 install failure reported
findings.proposed_mitigation: Disk free-space preflight and capacity reservation, separate from kernel crash attribution

findings.statement: Three historical 0x1000007F arg1=8 double-fault bugchecks reported
findings.proposed_mitigation: Analyze actual dumps with driver and hardware evidence; do not attribute to RAM or C: without proof

findings.statement: Unexpected Windows freezes and Kernel-Power/EventLog restart signatures reported
findings.proposed_mitigation: Correlate WER/dumps/kernel events; do not infer Codex causation from temporal proximity

findings.statement: Codex resumed thread can use unexpected working directory and AGENTS.md
findings.proposed_mitigation: Bind project/root/CWD and permission snapshot before turn and each host mutation

findings.statement: Multiple mirrors and copied implementations caused current versus candidate confusion
findings.proposed_mitigation: Bind exact source-root, content hash and lifecycle state; reject name-only matching

findings.statement: Chat-visible artifacts may not exist inside the local Codex execution filesystem
findings.proposed_mitigation: Preflight materialization, file hash and executor visibility

findings.statement: FORGEPRIME FPP 0.1.0 and local adapter closure reported, not product-activated here
findings.proposed_mitigation: Use genuine current FPP host adapter, not synthetic oracle; readiness never grants execution authority

findings.statement: Hashes can be invalidated between readiness and actual execution
findings.proposed_mitigation: Use immutable inputs or renewed identity check at execution boundary

findings.statement: Already available historical code can be rebuilt into a parallel candidate when provenance is lost
findings.proposed_mitigation: Artifact lineage registry and explicit not-current status on missing originals

findings.statement: Codex attempted synthetic Alpha SKILL.md read despite exclude marker in frontmatter; body failed to load
findings.proposed_mitigation: Check full positive-and-negative applicability before read; distinguish tool attempt vs host selection

findings.statement: Separate setup refresh had errors blocked the excluded skill body-load
findings.proposed_mitigation: Expose setup error and retry policy independently from routing decision

findings.statement: No host-provided complete selection/body-load evidence was available
findings.proposed_mitigation: Expose redacted structured selection and body-load receipt IDs

findings.statement: SkillSuite visibility and plugin availability differed across Chat/Work/Codex surfaces
findings.proposed_mitigation: Host/version/skill-root fingerprint per session; do not assume cross-host parity

findings.statement: Native Computer Use app approval timed out before probehost creation
findings.proposed_mitigation: Separate approval/request/expiry receipts and provide supported reconnect flow

findings.statement: Native input GetCursorPos failed 0x80070005
findings.proposed_mitigation: Distinguish current input desktop, granted app target and correct OS-permitted path

findings.statement: Input desktop ACCESS_DENIED_5 in local GUI probes
findings.proposed_mitigation: Fail closed with actionable approval/desktop state; no UAC/ACL bypass

findings.statement: Capture timed out and UIAutomation unavailable during local probe
findings.proposed_mitigation: Require capture+input+visible state+process close as separate acknowledgments

findings.statement: No supported reattach action was exposed in the examined run
findings.proposed_mitigation: Vendor support to confirm recovery; do not fabricate APIs

findings.statement: Text-mode cross-runtime stdin mutated line endings
findings.proposed_mitigation: Write binary stdin and compare sent/received bytes in local canary

findings.statement: Guest delimiter and output record schema mismatch
findings.proposed_mitigation: Validate exact framed bytes, type, cardinality and completion marker

findings.statement: Guest main() not invoked, output empty with zero exit
findings.proposed_mitigation: Direct entrypoint and semantic completion regression

findings.statement: VM110 SYSTEMD_UNIT_LIST was stopped by SECRET_BOUNDARY_STOP prior to runtime discovery
findings.proposed_mitigation: Server-side narrow structural allowlist; fail-closed protected candidates and coverage counts

findings.statement: Discovery source limit could omit relevant candidates
findings.proposed_mitigation: Bounded coverage receipt listing unknown/unread categories; do not claim complete discovery

findings.statement: MailCert Gate B remains independently restricted
findings.proposed_mitigation: Do not reuse consumed live gates or infer authorization from readiness

findings.statement: OwnerBridge two no-restore Release builds ended exit 1 MSB5021 without preceding cause log
findings.proposed_mitigation: Capture first cancellation trigger, process tree and binlog; no source blame from MSB5021 alone

findings.statement: Three projects and 30 C# files correspond to OwnerBridge only, not complete AngelWings
findings.proposed_mitigation: Require project/assembly/function contract and runtime proof before full-product PASS

findings.statement: Passing mock tests missed generated guest output and entrypoint defects
findings.proposed_mitigation: Run actual generated program through local synthetic transport and strict parser

findings.statement: Historical forensic helper could return exit 0 despite WARN
findings.proposed_mitigation: Nonzero exit for blocking incomplete/failed gates; test status and process code

findings.statement: Metadata scan reported 2947 denied directories and 161 skipped reparse points
findings.proposed_mitigation: Scope and coverage explicit; never promote partial scan to full source authority

findings.statement: Historic PASS/current and proof vs approval frequently conflated
findings.proposed_mitigation: Versioned immutable receipt with schema, source digest and validity stage

findings.statement: Windows app could show starting UI without turn/start acknowledgment
findings.proposed_mitigation: Separate APP_READY/THREAD_ACK/TURN_ACK/EXEC_ACK and committed result

findings.statement: iOS and desktop can show different project assignments for same thread
findings.proposed_mitigation: Canonical project/thread revision and drift readback

findings.statement: Remote compaction context errors left a saved thread unusable
findings.proposed_mitigation: Bounded retry, durable snapshot and explicit resumable error

findings.statement: iOS remote may leave desktop session locked after remote close
findings.proposed_mitigation: Writer-lease transfer with fencing token and timeout, no blind lock removal

findings.statement: Media and tool attachments not always replayed identically across clients
findings.proposed_mitigation: Stable redacted artifact handles and pagination with explicit unavailable state

findings.statement: A suspicious January timestamp was visible in an October Codex interface
findings.proposed_mitigation: Inspect stored epoch/client timezone before asserting persistence corruption

findings.statement: 1,749,996 members verified by archive inventory, not every member content as Vault source
findings.proposed_mitigation: Content reads of bounded manifests and candidate roots; preserve historical context

findings.statement: 3,123 Vault path hits but zero directly bound Vault csproj/sln; current identity unknown
findings.proposed_mitigation: Resolve project manifests, namespace and code, never count path hits as source files

findings.statement: One complete 1,134-part archive family and a separate incomplete 5-part family reported
findings.proposed_mitigation: Keep families disjoint by digest and provenance; never substitute parts

findings.statement: First-product-keyword path classifier can misassign GuardApp and other sources
findings.proposed_mitigation: Multi-label classification with explicit abstention and exact project binding

findings.statement: A synthetic fixture creator recursively removes an existing destination
findings.proposed_mitigation: Refuse pre-existing roots; never accept volume/workspace roots as fixture target

findings.statement: Found old source trees are not proof of current/active product
findings.proposed_mitigation: Bind live root manifest plus exact hashes, tests and active state before Current

findings.statement: 0.4.0-rc1 planner mapped shortened vendor Goo to Google Chrome and PASS_FIXED
findings.proposed_mitigation: Exact normalized vendor identity and explicit aliases with negative tests

findings.statement: 0.4.0-rc1 free text leaked Bearer credentials after partial key redaction
findings.proposed_mitigation: Full credential-scheme header redaction; negative publication canaries

findings.statement: 0.4.0-rc1 wheel verifier overlooked duplicate archive members and invalid RECORD
findings.proposed_mitigation: Reject duplicates/unsafe paths; verify every RECORD digest, size, source byte and metadata version

findings.statement: Historical candidate evidence was labeled current and changelog headings repeated
findings.proposed_mitigation: New 0.4.1-rc1 evidence with explicit historical references; one changelog heading

findings.statement: Native Windows GitHub CI and actual FPP host validation are not performed here
findings.proposed_mitigation: Require real Windows CI, versioned FPP receipt and owner push authority before public release
